plan.title: fix(skills,docs): untangle RWLDL from deft-pre-pr — naming and discoverability cleanup

narratives.Description: Untangle RWLDL naming from deft-directive-pre-pr: pre-pr prose uses Read-Write-Lint-Diff not RWLDL loop; formerly note points to tools/RWLDL.md; remove rwldl trigger routing to pre-pr; REFERENCES discoverability for RWLDL as distinct tool. narratives.Overview:
## Problem

RWLDL (`tools/RWLDL.md`) and `deft-pre-pr` are two distinct loops that have been conflated through naming. This causes confusion about what each one does.

- **`tools/RWLDL.md`** — general-purpose iterative quality improvement loop (micro/macro review cycles, performance, security, coverage ≥95%, benchmarks). Development-time tool. State tracked in `ldl-progress.md`.
- **`skills/deft-pre-pr`** — PR readiness check (Read-Write-Lint-Diff until zero changes). Narrow scope: RFC2119 markers, spec acceptance criteria, scope creep, `task check`. No persistent state.

`deft-pre-pr` was formerly `deft-rwldl` and diverged from the original concept, but retained the name in several places.

## Changes

### 1. `skills/deft-pre-pr/SKILL.md` — fix anti-pattern language

The anti-patterns use "RWLDL loop" to refer to the Read-Write-Lint-Diff loop, which is not the same thing.

Replace: `⊗ Submit a PR without running the RWLDL loop`
With: `⊗ Submit a PR without running this pre-PR loop (Read-Write-Lint-Diff)`

Apply the same correction to any other internal references that call the deft-pre-pr loop "RWLDL".

### 2. `skills/deft-pre-pr/SKILL.md` — clarify the "Formerly" note

Current: `**Formerly `deft-rwldl`** -- renamed to clearly communicate the skill's purpose`

Replace with something like: `**Formerly `deft-rwldl`** -- renamed and scoped to PR readiness. For the broader iterative quality improvement loop (micro/macro review), see [tools/RWLDL.md](../../tools/RWLDL.md).`

This makes the relationship and the divergence explicit rather than leaving the reader to infer that deft-pre-pr and RWLDL are the same thing.

### 3. `AGENTS.md` — remove `"rwldl"` from `deft-pre-pr` triggers

Current routing:
```
"pre-pr" / "quality loop" / "rwldl" / "self-review" → skills/deft-pre-pr/SKILL.md
```

Remove `"rwldl"` from this list. Someone invoking "rwldl" wants the micro/macro quality improvement loop, not the PR readiness check. Leave `"pre-pr"`, `"quality loop"`, and `"self-review"` as triggers for `deft-pre-pr`.

### 4. `REFERENCES.md` — add `tools/RWLDL.md` entry

RWLDL.md is not currently in REFERENCES.md, making it undiscoverable. Add one line under the quality/code review section:

```
- **[tools/RWLDL.md](./tools/RWLDL.md)** — iterative micro/macro code quality improvement loop
  - Load: When doing deep quality work outside the PR readiness context
```

## Out of scope

Creating a `deft-refine` skill to wrap RWLDL.md is a separate, future piece of work. These four changes are self-contained cleanup only.


---

## Issue comment thread

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-04-20T04:06:46Z)

## Coordination with #435 Risk-11 (2026-04-20)

Per post-walkthrough triage. Both this issue (RWLDL / deft-pre-pr naming and discoverability cleanup) and the #435 Risk-11 addendum (https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/435#issuecomment-4277610167) edit `skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md`. Need to sequence or bundle to avoid conflicts.

### What #435 Risk-11 adds to `deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md`

- `task roadmap:render` added to Phase 3b (symmetric with existing SPEC + PRD).
- Soft-failure contract documented ("log and continue on render failure").

### What this issue asks

- Untangle RWLDL naming from deft-pre-pr.
- Improve discoverability.
- Likely touches the same file's heading structure and skill frontmatter.

### Recommended approach

**Option A: bundle both changes into a single PR.** RWLDL untangle touches the skill's identity / naming; the Risk-11 additions touch Phase 3b behavior. Same file, coherent story: "refactor and extend pre-pr skill."

**Option B: sequence with this first, Risk-11 second.** RWLDL untangle lands first (possibly with its own PR), Risk-11 addenda land as part of #435's aggregator PR. Small merge-conflict risk if heading structure changes between commits.

**My recommendation: Option A.** One PR owns all pre-pr edits for v0.20.0. Reviewer has one coherent surface to review. No inter-PR conflict window.

### Triage decision

- **If this issue is scoped small enough** to land in v0.20.0, it becomes either an additional GA blocker OR a scope amendment to #435.
- **If this issue wants broader restructuring** (e.g. renaming the whole skill), likely post-GA -- would delay GA.

Needs your call on scope and timing. For now: this issue is not yet on the v0.20.0 blocker list. Flag me if you want it added or bundled into #435.

### Related

- #437 -- v0.20.0 rendering tracker.
- #435 -- spec_render.py lifecycle aggregator (Risk-11 addendum covers Phase 3b auto-render additions).
- PR #403 -- v0.20.0 release-cutting PR.


### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-03T01:02:36Z)

## Current shape (as of 2026-08-02)

**Status:** **Keep open.** Skill is renamed to **`deft-directive-pre-pr`**, but **naming conflation with RWLDL remains** in skill prose, triggers, and discoverability. Small, self-contained docs/skill cleanup — not an epic.

### Two concepts (do not merge)

| Concept | Role | Location |
|---|---|---|
| **Pre-PR loop** | PR readiness: Read → Write → Lint → Diff until zero changes; `task check` at merge chokepoint | `skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md` (always-pin) |
| **RWLDL** | Broader iterative micro/macro quality improvement loop (deep quality work, not only PR readiness) | `tools/RWLDL.md` |

Historical: pre-pr was formerly `deft-rwldl` and diverged; residual “RWLDL” language still points people at the wrong tool.

### What’s done

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| Rename to `deft-directive-pre-pr` / `deft-directive-*` | Done |
| Pre-pr as always-pin / Skills Index entry | Done |
| `tools/RWLDL.md` present | Done |
| #435 Risk-11 Phase 3b render coordination | Historical (v0.20); **not** a current sequencing blocker |

### Residual (still open — body AC still valid)

Spot-check 2026-08-02:

| #449 item | Residual |
|---|---|
| 1. Anti-patterns / loop language | Still says **“RWLDL loop”** / “RWLDL iteration” for the **pre-pr** loop |
| 2. “Formerly `deft-rwldl`” note | Still short; should point at `tools/RWLDL.md` for the broader loop |
| 3. Triggers | **REFERENCES** (and similar) still route **`rwldl` → pre-pr** — wrong for someone who means the tool |
| 4. Discoverability | **`tools/RWLDL.md`** not clearly a distinct load path vs pre-pr in REFERENCES |

### Acceptance (when implemented)

- [ ] Pre-pr skill anti-patterns and body say **pre-PR / Read-Write-Lint-Diff**, not “RWLDL loop,” for this skill’s loop
- [ ] Formerly note: renamed from `deft-rwldl`; broader quality loop → `tools/RWLDL.md`
- [ ] Remove **`rwldl`** as a pre-pr trigger; keep `pre-pr`, `quality loop`, `self-review` (or equivalent)
- [ ] REFERENCES (and any agents-entry / Skills Index mirrors): RWLDL under tools for deep quality work; pre-pr only for PR readiness
- [ ] Pack source of truth updated if skills/rules are pack-rendered (`packs:render`)

### Explicit non-goals

- ⊗ Creating a new `deft-refine` skill that wraps RWLDL (future work if ever)
- ⊗ Renaming `tools/RWLDL.md` or redesigning the pre-pr algorithm
- ⊗ Always-on AGENTS essay about the distinction

### Implementation shape

**Single small PR** (docs + skill + REFERENCES/pack). No engine/CI change required.

### Related

- **#450** — broader markdown→skills migration (larger; do not block #449 on it)
- Pre-pr always-pin / #2508 class process

### Reading order

1. This comment  
2. Issue body (four concrete edits)  
3. Live `deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md` + `tools/RWLDL.md` + REFERENCES Skills Index
